items.name: _style-theme
items.title: Video.js media theme
items.description: Editable shared media tokens, resets, preferences, and Tailwind compiler integration.

@utility font-media.font-family: var(--media-font-family, "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif)

@utility transition-media-menu-resize.transition-property: opacity, filter, transform, scale, width, height
@utility transition-media-menu-resize.transition-duration: var(--media-duration-fast), var(--media-duration-fast), var(--media-duration-fast), var(--media-duration-fast), var(--media-duration-menu), var(--media-duration-menu)

@utility clip-media-x-*.right: max( calc(100% - var(--value([*]), 0%)), calc(100% - var(--media-slider-chapter-end, 100%) + var(--media-spacing) * var(--media-chapter-inset-end, 0)) )

@utility clip-media-y-*.top: max( calc(100% - var(--value([*]), 0%)), calc(100% - var(--media-slider-chapter-end, 100%) + var(--media-spacing) * var(--media-chapter-inset-end, 0)) )

items.docs: Installed automatically with Video.js skins and UI components. Use UI components inside an installed skin, or set `data-theme="default"` and `data-preset` on a custom `Container`. See [Customize skins](https://videojs.org/docs/framework/react/how-to/customize-skins/) for theme customization.
